name: Santa Clara County Social Services Agency
description: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKs and General Assistance applications for Santa Clara County residents.
fullDescription: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKs and General Assistance applications for Santa Clara County residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medi-Cal applications, renewals and eligibility questions
- CalFresh (food stamps) applications and recertification
- CalWORKs cash aid for families with children
- General Assistance for adults without children
- In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) intake
howToGetIt: Apply online at BenefitsCal.com any time, or call to find the nearest office and start an application by phone.
keywords: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, food stamps, CalWORKs, General Assistance, benefits office, apply, Santa Clara County, San Jose, social services agency
